items.q: How can a production-grade MVP be built in only 30 days?
items.a: We do not start from scratch with boilerplate code. Trai Inc utilizes pre-hardened, SOC-2 compliant modules for auth, multi-tenant database schemas, payment webhooks, and administrative dashboards. Dedicated senior pods focus exclusively on your unique product logic and UX, allowing us to ship clean, production software in four milestone sprints.

items.q: Do I keep 100% equity in my startup?
items.a: Yes. In our Fixed-Fee Founder Sprint track, you retain 100% equity, full source code ownership, and all intellectual property. We act purely as your elite engineering pod. If you apply for and are accepted into our Hybrid Venture Co-Build track, we offer discounted development fees in exchange for a small (2–5%) advisory equity stake.

items.q: What support do you provide for DPIIT Recognition and Startup India Seed Fund (SISFS)?
items.a: We prepare your entire DPIIT application package, Detailed Project Report (DPR), and financial justifications required for the Startup India Seed Fund Scheme (up to ₹50 Lakhs for commercialization). Our compliance team ensures your entity structure, patent/IP documentation, and innovation criteria meet incubator evaluation standards.

items.q: How can I meet the engineering team before signing?
items.a: All technical scoping and architecture discovery calls are conducted online via high-bandwidth video meetings (Google Meet / Zoom). You will meet directly with our senior software architects and incubator leadership to review user journeys, technical scope, and delivery timelines.

items.q: What tech stack do you recommend for startup MVPs?
items.a: We recommend modern, battle-tested stacks that scale smoothly without expensive rewrites: Next.js or React with TypeScript for frontend, Node.js or Python FastAPI for backend services, PostgreSQL or Cloudflare D1 for databases, and Flutter for cross-platform mobile apps. This ensures rapid iteration, high performance, and minimal infrastructure overhead.

items.q: What happens after the 30-day MVP is launched?
items.a: You own 100% of the code and repository. You can take the codebase in-house, have your own engineering hires maintain it, or continue partnering with Trai Inc via our dedicated engineering pod retainer for continuous feature sprints and scale.
